# GitHub Copilot adapter

Read and follow the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working anywhere in
this repository, including subdirectory and cloud tasks. It is the canonical
contract for architecture, applicable checks, privacy and release/human gates.

Keep shared rules there, not duplicated here. Local-only references and tools
are not automatically available in hosted environments; report missing evidence
instead of treating a pushed branch or open PR as merged or locally active.
